goal: Sign on to the MeridianCore servicing console, open Member Servicing, look up the member whose number is given by the member_id input, and read that member's Regular Savings account: its current balance and its status. Also read the member's name from the member record.
summary:
Signed on to MeridianCore, navigated to Member Servicing, looked up member 100244, and retrieved the Regular Savings account details: Current Balance $4,812.37, Status OPEN, and Member Name [REDACTED]:output:member_name. All three outputs extracted successfully. // Probed all four failure/notice scenarios on the live MeridianCore session:

1. Member not found (999999): Exact wording "No member matching that number was found." — registered as declare_outcome (member_not_found, return_to_caller).

2. Entitlement restriction (100999, EXECUTIVE SERVICES flag): Exact wording "You do not have permission to view this member." with detail "Member 100999 is flagged EXECUTIVE SERVICES. A supervisor override is required to continue." A "Supervisor Override" button is present, confirming a supervisor can clear it on the same session — registered as declare_outcome (access_restricted_executive_services, escalate_to_human).

3. Interstitial notice: A one-time "System Notice" (Scheduled maintenance window 02:00–03:00 CT...) appeared the first time Member Servicing was opened after sign-on, cleared via the "Acknowledge and Continue" button — registered as declare_recovery (scheduled_maintenance_notice). It only appears once per sign-on.

4. Deliberate host fault state: Looking up member 100244 again produced "SYSTEM ERROR MC-5001 / The host transaction could not be completed. Contact the service desk with this reference." — registered as declare_failure (host_transaction_error), since this must stop the run rather than be treated as a valid business answer.

All marker texts were copied exactly from the live screens and verified.

actions.intent: Sign on to the servicing console
actions.expect: Main menu or Member Servicing navigation appears

actions.intent: Open Member Servicing to look up the member
Dismiss the system notice to proceed to Member Servicing
Enter the member number to look up
Search for the member's account summary
actions.expect: Member record and account summary appear including Regular Savings

actions.intent: Go back to Member Servicing to search for a non-existent member
Enter a non-existent member number to see the not-found message
Search for the non-existent member to see the not-found message
actions.expect: A not-found or no-record message appears

actions.intent: Start a new search to look up the executive-services-flagged member
Enter the executive-services-flagged member number to check entitlement blocking
Search for the executive-services-flagged member to see the entitlement restriction message
actions.expect: An entitlement restriction or access denied message appears

actions.intent: Navigate back to Member Servicing to test the fault state lookup for member 100244
Enter member number 100244 to test the deliberate fault state
Search for member 100244 to trigger the deliberate host fault state

declared_outcomes.name: member_not_found
declared_outcomes.marker_text: No member matching that number was found.
declared_outcomes.message: The searched member number does not exist in the system. The caller should be told the member was not found.

declared_outcomes.name: access_restricted_executive_services
declared_outcomes.marker_text: You do not have permission to view this member.
declared_outcomes.message: Member 100999 is flagged EXECUTIVE SERVICES. A supervisor override is required to continue. A supervisor can clear this restriction on this same session via the Supervisor Override button.
declared_outcomes.remediation: Have a supervisor click the Supervisor Override button on this screen to clear the restriction and continue the lookup.

declared_recoveries.name: scheduled_maintenance_notice
declared_recoveries.marker_text: Scheduled maintenance window 02:00–03:00 CT. Batch posting may be delayed. This notice is shown once per sign-on.
declared_recoveries.description: A one-time system notice appears the first time Member Servicing is opened after sign-on, informing the operator of a scheduled maintenance window. It must be acknowledged before the Member Lookup form is shown. It only appears once per sign-on session.

declared_failures.name: host_transaction_error
declared_failures.marker_text:
SYSTEM ERROR MC-5001

The host transaction could not be completed. Contact the service desk with this reference.
declared_failures.message: The application returned a genuine host/system fault (SYSTEM ERROR MC-5001: The host transaction could not be completed. Contact the service desk with this reference.) while attempting to look up a member. This is not a legitimate business answer and the run must stop rather than being treated as a valid result.
